correctness.rationale: Known optimum-support decomposition into isolated K2 and m disjoint P4s. Exact removal/replacement case split gives 2 leaf, 1 internal middle, 4 middle mediated by isolated edge per P4, hence 7m and exact count/edge formula. Unique orbit grants vertex transitivity. Two separately implemented exhaustive n=5 enumerators test C(25,7)=480700 candidate masks and every possible one-codeword move, independently returning 7200 minima, degree 14, 50400 edges and a connected exchange graph with uniform ten-term shell vector ending at distance nine.
